# A page whose frontmatter omits the `updated` field passes the freshness
# rules vacuously, and the lint run completes normally.

exec akb init lint-updated-kb
cd lint-updated-kb

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write note.md

exec akb lint
stdout 'issue\(s\) found'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Note Without Updated
summary: A note whose frontmatter has no updated field
tags: linttest
---
Content without an updated field.
